source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Automatic Test fill step (70 mm)
steps.body: Run Automatic Test. During step 2, do valves open and basket fill to 70 mm before advancing?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Automatic Test. During step 2, do valves open and basket fill to 70 mm before advancing?

branches.label: Long fill or no pressure change

steps.title: Automatic Test drain step (3 mm)
steps.body: During step 3, does drain pump run and washer sense 3 mm water remaining?
steps.sourceExcerpt: During step 3, does drain pump run and washer sense 3 mm water remaining?

steps.title: Inspect pressure hose and dome
steps.body: Power off. Remove console. Hose secure at transducer and tub dome? Routed without pinch? Clear of water/suds/debris?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove console. Hose secure at transducer and tub dome? Routed without pinch? Clear of water/suds/debris?

steps.title: Service pressure hose
steps.body: Disconnect hose at main control, blow clear, fix routing, replace if leaking. Retest Automatic Test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect hose at main control, blow clear, fix routing, replace if leaking. Retest Automatic Test.

steps.title: Water level OK
steps.oemOutcome: On-board pressure transducer and hose path verified via Automatic Test.

steps.title: Replace main control
steps.oemOutcome: Hose path good — replace main control; calibrate and run Automatic Test.
